title: OpenMacros MVP: Build core tracking app with AI food recognition
description: Bilingual (English/Spanish), offline-first PWA for calorie and macro tracking. Includes manual food entry, AI photo analysis, and architecture ready for future device sync.

title: Phase 5: Polish & Testing
description: Comprehensive testing (unit, integration, manual). Bug fixes and UX refinements. Performance optimization. Accessibility audit. PWA manifest and service worker configuration.

title: Phase 1: Project Setup & Foundation
description: Initialize Next.js project with TypeScript, Tailwind, PWA. Install and configure shadcn/ui. Set up i18next with English/Spanish translations. Configure Dexie.js for IndexedDB with data models. Set up Jest + React Testing Library. Create basic app shell and routing.

title: Phase 4: AI Food Analysis
description: Camera component and photo capture. Image compression (max 1MB). OpenRouter API integration with optimized prompt. AI result display and editing. Save analysis to library functionality.

title: Phase 6: Documentation & Handoff
description: Architecture documentation for future sync implementation. Developer guide for contributing food library. Deployment instructions. Known issues and technical debt notes. Design documentation commit.

title: Phase 3: Food Library & Manual Entry
description: Seed food database with common foods (from USDA API). Food search with autocomplete. Manual food entry flow. Daily log CRUD operations. Dashboard with progress rings and entry list.

title: Phase 2: Onboarding & User Profile
description: Implement all onboarding screens and wizard. TDEE calculation logic (Mifflin-St Jeor equation). User profile CRUD operations. Basic settings screen. Target display and editing.
